SharedEvidence.rule: An A/B-common observed fact is not a reason why A is better and must not be duplicated as DifferenceEvidence for the same comparison fact.

FutureDifferenceCandidate.boundary: Typed handoff only. Sequence semantics and counterfactual timeline are Build19-2 responsibilities.

safetyRules.rule: SCORE_DIFFERENCE always has causalStrength=UNRESOLVED and cannot by itself become dominantDifferenceCandidate.
If no resolved grounded non-score difference exists, emit NO_GROUNDED_CAUSAL_DIFFERENCE.
CHECK_DIFFERENCE is an observed board consequence; its limitation explicitly forbids claiming that check alone explains the evaluation gap.

When the first opponent reply immediately recaptures the candidate mover, snapshot capture/material differences are downgraded to UNRESOLVED as causal reasons and exchange evidence is emitted at OPPONENT_REPLY horizon.
If same-condition normalization or candidate stability fails, dominantDifferenceCandidate is suppressed.
DifferenceEvidence represents grounded A/B differences or limited cause candidates, never a claim that one item explains the engine's full internal evaluation.

dominantEligibility: stable AND safeToVerbalize AND non-score AND causalStrength != UNRESOLVED
